# world-sim

> world-sim: from the laws of physics up to civilisation, one layer at a time. A set of simulation projects, the data they curated, and a pool of ideas.
> world-sim：从物理定律一层层往上，一直模拟到文明。这里是一组模拟项目、它们整理的数据，和一个想法池。

Everything below is read-only or a bounded, deterministic computation. No key is needed to read; nothing here calls a language model.
以下都是只读的，或者是有界的、确定性的计算。读不需要密钥；这里没有任何东西会调用语言模型。

## Start here / 从这里开始

- [Catalogue](/api/v1/catalog): every project, dataset and computation as JSON. Call this first. / 目录：全部项目、数据集和计算，JSON。先调它。
- [Full reference](/llms-full.txt): every dataset and computation with its fields, input schema and a runnable example. / 完整说明：每个数据集和计算的字段、输入和能直接跑的例子。
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json) · MCP endpoint: `/mcp` (or locally `uv run idea-loom mcp`).

## Projects / 项目

- **limn** — Goodsell-style scientific illustration / Goodsell 风格的科学插图: Goodsell-style illustrations of molecules and cells. Rendering happens in the browser only; what agents get here is its curated pointer data (which large models can be viewed, which PDB structures each Molecule of the Month covers, the lipid make-up of biological membranes) and a few lookups against public databases. Lookup results come from external databases and change as they do.
  - data [models](/api/v1/datasets/limn/models/schema): Viewable large models / 可看的大模型 (MIT (this index; each model keeps the licence stated in its record))
  - data [molecule-of-the-month](/api/v1/datasets/limn/molecule-of-the-month/schema): Molecule of the Month / 月度分子 (MIT (this index of titles and ids; the articles themselves belong to RCSB PDB))
  - data [membranes](/api/v1/datasets/limn/membranes/schema): Lipid make-up of membranes / 生物膜的脂质组成 (MIT)
  - run [ligand](/api/v1/capabilities/limn/ligand): Ligand 3D structure / 配体的三维结构
  - run [membrane-placement](/api/v1/capabilities/limn/membrane-placement): Placement of a membrane protein / 膜蛋白在膜里的位置
  - run [citation](/api/v1/capabilities/limn/citation): Summary and citation of a structure / 结构的概要和出处
  - run [alphafold](/api/v1/capabilities/limn/alphafold): Predicted structure / 预测结构
  - run [complexes](/api/v1/capabilities/limn/complexes): Predicted complexes / 预测的复合物
- **mindloop** — I know that you know that I know / 我知道你知道我知道: Two people guessing each other: I know that you know that I know. 25 sourced cases (the Empty Fort, Holmes and Moriarty, Poe's odd-or-even…). 16 of them carry a game (the record has a `game` field) and can be computed for "how many levels each side reasons"; the other 9 are readers with a level-by-level prose account only. Find a case id in `cases`, then run `compute`.
  - data [cases](/api/v1/datasets/mindloop/cases/schema): Cases / 案例 (MIT (summaries written for this repository; quoted works keep their own copyright))
  - run [compute](/api/v1/capabilities/mindloop/compute): Compute a case / 算一个案例
- **polis** — A parallel society: how one remark brings down a bank / 平行社会：一句闲话怎么挤垮一家钱庄: A parallel society: how a rumour spreads through a small town and turns into a bank run. Offered here are the corpus it rests on (theories, cases and stylised facts, each with sources and verification flags), the calibration targets, the age structures used for its populations, and one computation: run a simulation for a scenario and seed and get a summary. Start with facts and cases; call simulate to run one. Note that the model has not passed its out-of-sample tests, so a result is not a forecast for any real bank.
  - data [theory](/api/v1/datasets/polis/theory/schema): Theories / 理论 (MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright))
  - data [cases](/api/v1/datasets/polis/cases/schema): Cases / 案例 (MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright))
  - data [facts](/api/v1/datasets/polis/facts/schema): Stylised facts / 典型事实 (MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright))
  - data [calibration-targets](/api/v1/datasets/polis/calibration-targets/schema): Calibration targets / 校准目标 (MIT)
  - data [age-structure](/api/v1/datasets/polis/age-structure/schema): Age structure / 年龄结构 (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
  - run [simulate](/api/v1/capabilities/polis/simulate): Run one simulation / 跑一次模拟
- **soma** — 3D human anatomy / 三维人体解剖: 3D human anatomy (a teaching model, not a clinical reference): 3,332 male and 3,369 female anatomical parts (each with a concept id, mostly an FMA id), 8,760 relations (origins, insertions, innervation, blood supply and more), Chinese names, joint ranges of motion, dermatomes and cutaneous nerve territories. Nothing to simulate; this is data. No name or relation has been reviewed by a person. To answer "which nerve innervates this muscle": find the `fma` field of the part in `parts` by English name, then query `relations` with key=<fma>&where=kind=innervatedBy.
  - data [parts](/api/v1/datasets/soma/parts/schema): Anatomical parts / 解剖部件 (CC BY-SA 4.0 for the dataset as a whole; upstream sources are CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 2.1 JP, CC BY-SA 4.0 and Apache-2.0, listed under `sources` in the file)
  - data [parts-female](/api/v1/datasets/soma/parts-female/schema): Anatomical parts (female) / 解剖部件（女性） (CC BY-SA 4.0 for the dataset as a whole; upstream sources (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA, Apache-2.0, NLM terms with attribution) are listed under `sources` in the file)
  - data [relations](/api/v1/datasets/soma/relations/schema): Anatomical relations / 解剖关系 (CC BY-SA 4.0 (each record carries its own source licence: 8,151 are CC0 1.0 from Wikidata, 609 are CC BY-SA 4.0 from Wikipedia and Z-Anatomy))
  - data [names](/api/v1/datasets/soma/names/schema): Chinese names / 中文名称 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
  - data [range-of-motion](/api/v1/datasets/soma/range-of-motion/schema): Joint ranges of motion / 关节活动度 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
  - data [dermatomes](/api/v1/datasets/soma/dermatomes/schema): Dermatomes / 皮节 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
  - data [cutaneous-nerves](/api/v1/datasets/soma/cutaneous-nerves/schema): Cutaneous nerve territories / 皮神经分布区 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
- **strata** — From microscopic rules to emergence / 从微观规则到涌现: From microscopic rules to emergence: molecular dynamics, Ising, Potts, gravity, meshes and more, run on the GPU in a browser. It has no headless entry point yet, so there is no callable computation or dataset here for now; its card URLs in the catalogue can be given to a person to open.

## Idea pool / 想法池

- [Search](/api/v1/ideas?q=rumour): `/api/v1/ideas?q=&level=&thread=&kernel=&project=&full=` — titles by default, bodies with `full=true`; 107 live ideas, each a short prompt that can be handed to an agent to build a simulation. / 搜索想法池。
- One idea with history and lineage: `/api/v1/ideas/{id}` / 一条 idea 的全文、历史和血缘。

## Conventions / 约定

- JSON in, JSON out. Errors are `{"error": …, "hint": …}`; the hint says how to fix the request. / 只收发 JSON；错误带 hint，说明怎么改。
- Dataset queries: `?q=words&where=field=value&key=K&fields=a,b&limit=20&after=0`; `next` in the reply is the `after` for the next page. / 数据集的查询参数。
- Every dataset reply carries `licence` and `provenance`. Read them: some data is machine-gathered and unreviewed. / 每次返回都带许可和出处，有些数据是机器汇集、没有经人核对的。
- Text fields come in Chinese and English where both exist (`zh`/`en`, or `x`/`x_en`). / 文字有中英两版时都给。
